name: Harold Lister
source:
Favorite tea: Japanese tea

The heir to the Lister family, a merchant family that has gained wealth in recent years. As a newly established family, he is often the target of gossip. He has a friendly and approachable personality, but he will show his merchant side if given the chance, so you can't let your guard down. He also has a shrewd side. He is busy on the go with his work every day, so he tends to accumulate fatigue. He prefers tea with a bitter taste.

[Translated from the [url=https://dotaihen.xxxxxxxx.jp/tea/teaparty.htm]official website[/url]]
